top_signals.title: Online ad firm Adform’s script compromised to steal cryptocurrency
top_signals.summary: Online advertising firm Adform suffered a supply-chain attack that delivered cryptocurrency-stealing scripts to websites using its ad platform, replacing wallet addresses copied to visitors' clipboards with ones controlled by an attacker. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
